metadata.description: Menendez Market's Claude Code plugin marketplace

plugins.name: dev-orchestrator
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop orchestrator for multi-step dev tasks with a two-level agent hierarchy. Adopts the Lead's plan (drafts one in plan mode under opusplan only if none is given), maps step dependencies and asks whether to run as a single session or multi-agent. In multi-agent mode each step gets a Task Agent on the latest Sonnet, in its own terminal (orch-sN-name) or inline for small steps, and starts as soon as its dependencies finish. Task Agents reuse the orchestrator's research and may spawn read-only Research Sub-agents (Sonnet 4.6) that use graphify first. Never runs tests: checks run once at the end. Never guesses on ambiguity, architecture, or destructive/git actions: escalates to the Lead. Trigger phrases: "orchestrate this", "use dev-orchestrator", "plan and delegate this task", "run this plan with task agents".

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: QA agent suite: qa-orchestrator runs QA sessions (spawns test agents in parallel, collects results, triages bugs, generates reports); qa-happy-path tests the main UI flows with Playwright; qa-api-adversary tries to break the API (auth, input validation, duplicates, race conditions, malformed requests); qa-debugger applies minimal fixes for reported bugs; qa-personality-builder creates project-specific QA personalities. Installed together so the orchestrator always has the agents it spawns. Trigger with /qa-orchestrator, "run QA", "start QA session" or "test the PR".
